limitations.title: Int64 registration is not full-width arithmetic
limitations.finding: enableInt64 adds registrations, but the binary implementation explicitly documents low-32-bit i32 arithmetic and incorrect results outside the int32 range. Even small inputs can overflow intermediate results. This does not imply all int64 movement or Cast paths are truncated.
limitations.impact: Silent numerical errors are more serious than an unsupported-node error; full WebNN int64 semantics cannot be inferred from the option.
limitations.test: Test ±2^31, ±2^32, int64 extrema, unsigned-looking low words, comparisons and overflowing products against a reference; gate capability or implement full semantics.
limitations.needle: NOTE: int64 in the WebGPU shader

limitations.title: Limited numeric types
limitations.finding: The common floating-point kernel type list is float32/float16, not float64, bfloat16 or general FP8. Common numeric lists add int32/uint32; uint8, bool and int64 support is operator-specific, not universal.
limitations.impact: A supported name can still fail on a legal ONNX/WebNN dtype; blanket type support statements are unsafe.
limitations.test: Build a per-op dtype matrix; test permitted FP16 hardware/features, unsupported dtype rejection and accuracy before conversion.

limitations.title: Cast destination coverage
limitations.finding: The Cast shader has cases for float16, float32, int32, uint32, uint8, bool and int64. int8, uint16/int16, uint64, float64, bfloat16 and FP8 are not general destinations here. Current float→int64 code has a separate full-width conversion path; do not apply the binary low-32-bit statement indiscriminately.
limitations.impact: Chromium inserts Cast nodes, including signed/narrow quantization conversions. WebNN logical uint8↔bool conversions also need exact semantics.
limitations.test: Test every exposed source/destination pair, boundary values, NaN/Inf and packed outputs; inspect kernel type matching and runtime destination checks.

limitations.title: No int64 Pow registration
limitations.finding: The binary registration code deliberately excludes int64 from Pow, including its exponent type constraint.
limitations.impact: Mathematical and exported graphs can fail even with enableInt64=1.
limitations.test: Test base/exponent type combinations and negative/large exponents; do not use float conversion as an exact integer substitute.

limitations.title: GridSample opset and dimensionality gap
limitations.finding: Only opsets 16–19 are registered. The implementation accepts some newer mode spellings but requires 4-D NCHW input/grid with final grid dimension 2. That is not opset-20+ or volumetric support.
limitations.impact: Recent vision exporters can miss the kernel despite a familiar operator name.
limitations.test: Test opsets 16/19/20/22, 2-D versus 3-D, all interpolation/padding modes and empty dimensions; add explicit version/shape coverage.

limitations.title: Conv3D exists, but grouped Conv3D does not
limitations.finding: The native path supports 1-D/2-D/3-D convolution. Rank above five is rejected; the 3-D path requires group=1.
limitations.impact: Grouped/depthwise volumetric or video models remain a gap. The old JS documentation's blanket 'conv3d unsupported' statement is stale for native WebGPU.
limitations.test: Test group=1 and >1 in rank-five models; benchmark the existing naive path separately from correctness.

limitations.title: ConvTranspose3D absent
limitations.finding: The native implementation rejects ranks other than the 1-D/2-D paths.
limitations.impact: Volumetric decoders and segmentation upsampling can fail; ordinary 2-D transposed convolution is present.
limitations.test: Test rank-five input, groups, output_padding and output_shape; verify any rewrite is mathematically equivalent.

limitations.title: MaxPool indices / storage order
limitations.finding: Pool implementation requires storage_order=0 and one output; MaxPool's optional Indices output is rejected.
limitations.impact: Pooling/unpooling segmentation pipelines need indices; values-only inference is not the same contract.
limitations.test: Test both outputs, column-major storage, ties, dilations and ceil/padding rules.

limitations.title: BatchNormalization training mode
limitations.finding: trainingMode is explicitly rejected; inference BatchNormalization is registered.
limitations.impact: Not a blocker for a properly exported inference graph, but not training support.
limitations.test: Verify training_mode=0 export and optional output behavior; explicitly reject training requests.

limitations.title: Recurrent activation subset
limitations.finding: Native GRU and LSTM map sigmoid, tanh and relu activations to WGSL; other valid ONNX recurrent activation names throw.
limitations.impact: Default GRU/LSTM models have kernels, while non-default activation exports can fail. Double precision is also outside the common float type list.
limitations.test: Test supported directions/layouts/state/sequence lengths and each requested activation, including alpha/beta attributes where relevant.

limitations.title: Scatter reduction datatype restrictions
limitations.finding: Reduction paths accept int32, uint32 and float32; other registered data types such as float16 are rejected when reduction is not none.
limitations.impact: Accumulating indexed updates can fail even when a no-reduction scatter works; important to graph manipulation and some WebNN workloads.
limitations.test: Exercise add/mul/min/max, duplicate indices, fp16 versus fp32 and negative indices; validate atomic numerical behavior.

limitations.title: Dequantization does not imply quantization completeness
limitations.finding: Native DequantizeLinear registers int8/uint8/int32/int4/uint4 input formats and float16/float32 scales/output in newer opsets. It does not register all newer ONNX FP8/FP4/bfloat formats. QuantizeLinear itself has no native registration.
limitations.impact: QDQ exports must be audited in both directions; weight-only decompression support does not make an activation-quantized graph supported.
limitations.test: Test per-tensor, per-axis, blocked scales, omitted/asymmetric zero-points, signed packed values and zero/odd sizes.

limitations.title: Legacy Attention masks and cache
limitations.finding: Built-in and plugin capability checks reject mask_index, past, past_sequence_length, present output and past_present_share_buffer for com.microsoft.Attention.
limitations.impact: A fused encoder/decoder model may fall back despite the kernel registration; this is distinct from standard ai.onnx.Attention.
limitations.test: Test optional inputs/outputs and actual node placement with CPU fallback disabled; choose MHA/GQA only with a validated semantic conversion.
limitations.needle: Current implementation does not support mask_index

limitations.title: MultiHeadAttention packed inputs / padding mask
limitations.finding: Packed 5-D QKV/KV and key_padding_mask explicitly throw. The source does use past_key/past_value and supports causal execution; a blanket 'no past/present' claim is outdated.
limitations.impact: Transformer export layout and mask representation determine support.
limitations.test: Test separate versus packed Q/K/V, padding and additive attention bias, causal/noncausal, cache growth and output shapes.

limitations.title: GQA noncausal / sliding-window cache
limitations.finding: causal=0 and sliding_window_cache=1 are rejected. Sliding-window attention via local_window_size is not the same as CUDA's compacting sliding_window_cache mode.
limitations.impact: Bidirectional/vision attention and certain long-context cache exports cannot assume the decoder GQA kernel covers them.
limitations.test: Validate chosen cache/layout/causal attributes and shared-KV special cases; do not silently drop unsupported attributes.

limitations.title: PagedAttention feature subset
limitations.finding: Requires causal operation. Guards reject nonzero softcap, non-SEPARATE layout, unequal V head size, rotary offset, smooth softmax, quantized/non-float16 cache, slot_mapping, q/k norm weights and k/v scales.
limitations.impact: A registered PagedAttention name is not broad serving-model compatibility.
limitations.test: Test every requested cache format, optional input and paging boundary, including multi-request isolation; use the source-supported subset only.

limitations.title: Weight-only MatMulNBits variants
limitations.finding: The constructor allows 2/4/8-bit weights, but group_idx is rejected and explicit zero-points must be packed uint8. Support is not limited to INT4, nor does it cover all quantization formats.
limitations.impact: Group-index/activation-order and alternate zero-point exports can fail; relevant to LLM model builders.
limitations.test: Test bit width, block size, odd dimensions, bias, zero-points, accuracy settings and the exact exported weight packing.

limitations.title: MatMulBnb4 transpose constraint
limitations.finding: Built-in GetCapability rejects transB=0. The plugin capability implementation inspected here does not mirror this specific guard; registration parity does not guarantee rejection/fallback parity.
limitations.impact: Export options and built-in versus plugin builds can behave differently.
limitations.test: Run transB=0/1 models on both deployment paths; verify error/fallback rather than assuming the guard is shared.
limitations.needle: Current implementation only supports the forward case

limitations.title: LinearAttention state window
limitations.finding: state_window > 0 is explicitly unsupported (CUDA-only path); ordinary registered LinearAttention is not every stateful variant.
limitations.impact: Hybrid/state-space model exports can depend on this feature.
limitations.test: Test initialization, update and reset of state, window length and the exact model's export attributes.

limitations.title: GatedDeltaNet capture/state-update variants
limitations.finding: The native kernel rejects positive state_update_capacity and a capture_count input.
limitations.impact: Speculative/state-history variants can be missing despite basic hybrid-model support.
limitations.test: Exercise decode/prefill and every optional state-management input in the target export.

limitations.title: MRotaryEmbedding cache updates
limitations.finding: Updating cos_cache and sin_cache is not implemented.
limitations.impact: Multimodal models requiring runtime cache growth need another export or cache management strategy.
limitations.test: Precompute adequate caches where valid; test offset/length boundaries and optional updated-cache outputs.

limitations.title: NGram token IDs
limitations.finding: Native NGramHashMapping requires int32 IDs.
limitations.impact: An exporter using int64 IDs cannot infer compatibility from registration alone.
limitations.test: Range-check before converting IDs; verify hashing equivalence and overflow behavior.
